nina: FYI after the 03:10 deploy I'm seeing ~15% p50 regression on hosted text-gen. p99 up too. GPU looks fine, host CPU spike. :eyes:

rory: ack. can you paste flamegraph or hotspots?

nina: flame shows host preproc hotpath around tokenization + streaming frame emit. syscall counts for writev up ~3x. sample strace:

nina: ```
writev(1, [{iov_base="...", iov_len=128}], 1) = 128
writev(1, [{iov_base="...", iov_len=256}], 1) = 256
writev(1, [{iov_base="...", iov_len=64}], 1) = 64
```

amir: i deployed the token-shim change yesterday to handle edge zero-copy cases. Could be splitting buffers.

song: on prod we stream framed protobufs over gRPC. If tokenizer emits many small iovs we hit lots of writev and system call overhead -> tails.

rory: confirmed locally: new shim produces many 64-512B fragments vs previous ~2k chunks. ingress framer expected larger chunks for efficient coalescing.

luca: also saw kvcache eviction tick up in same window. microbench suggests smaller fragments reduce batching efficiency and increase kernel-switch frequency.

megan: can we quickly toggle back the shim? If it's the culprit we should roll back.

amir: i can flip it. short-term fix: add fallback at gRPC write layer to coalesce small iovs into a single buffer before send. that avoids a full revert.

rory: also propose adaptive coalescing heuristic: when avg_writev_per_req > 3, raise coalesce_threshold to 1k. quick pseudocode:

rory: ```cpp
if (avg_writev_per_req > 3) coalesce_threshold = max(coalesce_threshold, 1024);
```

rory: my microbench with that change + framer coalesce brings p50 back and p99 down ~7% in simulated tiny-token load.

nina: good. add metric "ingress.frags_per_req" and alert if it correlates with kvcache.eviction_rate > 0.5%/min. we need an observability link for ops.

luca: i'll add grafana panel and alert rule.

nina: also can we sample requests that emit >10 iovs (0.1% sample) and write them to s3 for replay? would help root cause tokenizer behavior.

amir: adding sampling flag + fallback coalesce PR. will keep zero-copy default but do coalesce as safety.

megan: rolling rollback queued -> staging 03:40, prod 04:00 if staging OK. deploy-bot: rollback queued

deploy-bot: deploy queued: rollback token-shim -> staging at 03:40 UTC, prod at 04:00 UTC if staging passes

song: after rollback we should still merge adaptive heuristic and framer fallback. prevents recurrence with other tokenizers.

nina: assign follow-ups: amir -> fallback coalesce PR, rory -> adaptive heuristic + tests, luca -> dashboard + alert, nina -> sample profiler + replay harness. reconvene in 2h.

infra-bot: rollback completed, latency returned to baseline. incident closed. artifact/rollback-1745612345

nina: thanks all :thumbsup: closing thread. if any deeper root cause found (tokenizer library copying) please add brief postmortem.
